messages:
lin: dropping a quick prototype — 'Capacity editor v3' that adds an inline quota simulator and keyboard-first controls. https://figma.redwood/capacity-v3 :dart:
jo: nice! simulator idea is great. could it show 'likely approval vs quota bump' as green/amber/red so users know if they'll hit a hard block
ade: UX nits: the min/max inputs are kinda small. suggestion: compact stepper + direct text entry. also add a small helper: 'press / to jump to pool search'
rachel: copy: the tooltip currently says 'min' and 'max' — can we make it explicit? e.g., 'Minimum reserved GPUs (always on)' and 'Maximum autoscale GPUs (including burst)'. helps with support tickets
lin: good, i'll update copy. on the simulator: it runs a quick calc based on project quota and reserved capacity. shows estimated monthly cost delta and a 95th percentile tail-latency estimate; opt-in on privacy for telemetry
jo: keyboard accessibility: allow modifier + arrows to adjust by larger increments, double-tap for x10. aria-describedby should point to the simulator summary when values change
ade: visual: pool selector currently groups by region; suggestion: show type badge (text-first) and a tiny 'available' count. color only used for status is bad for contrast
lin: implemented a prototype of the simulator payload for backend:
```
POST /api/v1/capacity/simulate
{
  "pool_id": "pool-7c9",
  "min": 6,
  "max": 24,
  "burst_minutes": 30
}
```
response includes: estimated_cost_delta, quota_ok (bool), tail_latency_ms_estimate
rachel: can the simulator also show 'likely batching impact' note — e.g., "If you increase min, batching improves and cost per token drops" small ephemeral tip under cost estimate
jo: guardrail language: avoid scary phrasing. suggested wording: "This configuration may approach your quota. Apply will request capacity and could affect billing." also add 'Request increase' inline action if quota_ok == false
ade: propose an undo snackbar for 10s after apply, and a detailed activity log entry linking to the exact settings changed
lin: design-bot, can you generate updated frames with: larger steppers, direct entry, simulator panel placement (right rail), keyboard hints and the new copy?
design-bot: created update 1725051300 1490 https://figma.redwood/flow/1725051300 :white_check_mark:
lin: one more ask — on mobile the simulator rail should collapse to a single summary row to save space. add a chevron to expand
rachel: accessibility follow-up: read out the simulator result with aria-live when values are applied; avoid announcing cost in currency if user prefers rounding or unitless estimates
jo: agree. and let's A/B test 'simulator visible by default' vs 'collapsed by default' to see if it reduces support tickets
lin: thanks team. i'll push updated comps & copy this afternoon and tag infra for the simulate endpoint. closing thread after designs land :rocket:
